svg.title: Worker lifecycle and runtime signals
svg.desc: A worker loads, analyzes and finalizes one model under heartbeat, stage-time, RAM and cache monitoring. Cleanup confirms process-group exit, removes the private cache and then releases GPUs. SIGHUP reloads live policy at a safe point, SIGUSR1 finishes active work without starting new models, and SIGINT or SIGTERM terminates, confirms exit and cleans up. An unconfirmed exit keeps evidence and stops dispatch.
